unusual_experiment.name: PROVIDER_IDENTITY_AUTHORITY_CONTRADICTION_FALSIFIER
unusual_experiment.question: Does current main express one coherent concrete external API-provider law without creating or implying a second cognition authority?
counterhypotheses: The shipped Mistral acceptance mode is a stale second cognition authority and should be removed from the product entrypoint.
The Mistral mode is bounded inference-only acceptance instrumentation, while the real defect is unresolved provider-law/name drift across current authority files.
observations: Current owner directive and ARCHITECTURE.md keep Browser -> Clerk -> WebSocket PTY -> persistent tmux -> normal interactive Claude Code as the canonical visible product path and UnifiedDB/EffectGate as state/effect authority.
Current manifest.json separately names GLM as token/API inference-only and states provider switching must preserve the same UnifiedDB causal turn/session/generation.
Current clayverse/service.py still imports and exposes a --mistral-once final acceptance probe that re-enters UnifiedDB/EffectGate and explicitly claims no Clerk/browser acceptance credit.

Existing retained draft PRs #682/#684 already define the non-duplicate provider-generic fusion direction: native Claude Code terminal inference plus audited API adapters as inference-only providers; Mistral is an acceptance profile rather than unique authority.
PRs #682/#684 are currently draft, stale against main, and non-mergeable, so their source cannot be promoted as current-main runtime truth.
unusual_experiment.interpretation: No evidence justifies deleting the Mistral acceptance probe merely because it exists. The source-level defect is that current main does not express one coherent concrete API-provider identity/law across manifest, architecture, and service. This remains a source-coherence blocker and must be reconciled through the existing provider-generic lane rather than by creating a duplicate provider path.
unusual_experiment.falsifier_for_this_result: A newer explicit owner directive plus exact current source showing a single provider identity/contract consistently across manifest, architecture, service/adapters, tests and acceptance controller would collapse this drift finding.

coordination.reason: Avoid a second permanent cognition/provider path.

go_deltas: Merged PR #1167 earlier in this macrocycle to restore current ClayVerse one-container authority after Mini Entity control-plane drift.
Recorded exactly one unusual provider-authority contradiction falsifier without claiming executable behavior.
Rejected the initially plausible but unsupported repair of simply deleting --mistral-once.

execution_evidence.note: No exact-current started product runtime was observed by this organ in this macrocycle. Source inspection and repository coordination do not imply runtime acceptance.

next: Rebase/adjudicate the single retained provider-generic source lane onto current ClayVerse main, close manifest/architecture/service provider-law drift without adding a second authority, then run exact-current authorized isolated regressions/OCI gates when an executable admitted surface is available.
